items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: And this guy, Hampton, playing trombone.

ctx.x: Then you lived in New Orleans from then on?

Yeah. Outside of the times when we was on the road, you know, going different places. Did you go on the road a lot? Oh yeah, when you see them bands, we used to give them gigs all through Louisiana, Texas, and different places like that. You know. And I was out there with Ike Garnett, with a group in Crowley, they're called the Yelping Hounds, I was out there with a group out there, and Victor De Spencer at the Shadowland, Victor De Spencer got the Shadowland. Well he had a band, he had a band too, with old man…
Was this the Yelping Hounds you're talking about?
